parole.significato: dombra (long-necked lute of Turkic or Central Asian origin)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Kazakh домбыра (dombıra), from Persian دنب بره (donb-e barre, literally “lamb's tail”). Related to Ottoman Turkish طنبوره (tanbura/tambura), Turkish tambura, Romanian tambură, Arabic طُنْبُور (ṭunbūr), etc. Doublet of до́мра (dómra) and танбу́р (tanbúr).

parole.significato: a large bag in which cotton is collected
parole.testo: Borrowed from Kazakh қанар (qanar) (Uzbek qanor), from Persian کنار (kanâr, “side, edge, border”) apparently because the sack was to the side of man, or the sacks were at the border of the field, during reaping.
1920s, from Kazakh лобия (lobıya), from Persian لوبیا (lôbiyâ).
1920s, from Kazakh мәш (mäš), from Persian ماش (mâš)
